sql_q1:
SELECT 
            season AS `Mua_Giai`,
            COUNT(*) AS `Tong_Giao_Dich`,
            COUNT(CASE WHEN fee_eur > 0 THEN 1 END) AS `So_Thuong_Vu_Co_Phi`,
            ROUND(SUM(fee_eur) / 1000000, 2) AS `Tong_Chi_Tieu_Mil_EUR`,
            ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN fee_eur > 0 THEN fee_eur END) / 1000000, 2) AS `Phi_TB_Mil_EUR`,
            ROUND(MAX(fee_eur) / 1000000, 2) AS `Ky_Luc_Mua_Mil_EUR`
        FROM fact_transfer
        GROUP BY season
        ORDER BY season ASC
sql_q2:
SELECT 
            player_name AS `Cau_Thu`,
            season AS `Mua`,
            from_club_name AS `CLB_Di`,
            to_club_name AS `CLB_Den`,
            transfer_type AS `Loai_Hinh`,
            ROUND(fee_eur / 1000000, 2) AS `Phi_Mil_EUR`,
            ROUND(market_value_eur / 1000000, 2) AS `Dinh_Gia_Mil_EUR`,
            transfer_date AS `Ngay_Ky`
        FROM fact_transfer
        WHERE fee_eur > 0
        ORDER BY fee_eur DESC
        LIMIT 10
sql_q3:
WITH spending AS (
            SELECT 
                to_pl_club AS club_id,
                to_club_name AS club_name,
                COUNT(*) AS buy_count,
                SUM(fee_eur) AS total_spent
            FROM fact_transfer
            WHERE to_pl_club IS NOT NULL AND to_pl_club != ''
            GROUP BY to_pl_club, to_club_name
        ),
        income AS (
            SELECT 
                from_pl_club AS club_id,
                COUNT(*) AS sell_count,
                SUM(fee_eur) AS total_income
            FROM fact_transfer
            WHERE from_pl_club IS NOT NULL AND from_pl_club != ''
            GROUP BY from_pl_club
        )
        SELECT 
            s.club_id AS `Ma_CLB`,
            s.club_name AS `Ten_CLB`,
            s.buy_count AS `So_Ban_Hop_Dong_Mua`,
            ROUND(s.total_spent / 1000000, 2) AS `Tong_Chi_Mil_EUR`,
            COALESCE(i.sell_count, 0) AS `So_Thuong_Vu_Ban`,
            ROUND(COALESCE(i.total_income, 0) / 1000000, 2) AS `Tong_Thu_Mil_EUR`,
            ROUND((s.total_spent - COALESCE(i.total_income, 0)) / 1000000, 2) AS `Chi_Rong_NetSpend_Mil_EUR`
        FROM spending s
        LEFT JOIN income i ON s.club_id = i.club_id
        ORDER BY s.total_spent DESC
        LIMIT 10
sql_q4:
SELECT 
            season AS `Mua_Giai`,
            transfer_type AS `Loai_Hinh`,
            COUNT(*) AS `So_Luong`,
            ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY season), 2) AS `Ty_Le_Pct`,
            ROUND(SUM(fee_eur) / 1000000, 2) AS `Tong_Phi_Mil_EUR`
        FROM fact_transfer
        GROUP BY season, transfer_type
        ORDER BY season ASC, `So_Luong` DESC
sql_q5:
WITH club_spend_2324 AS (
            SELECT 
                to_pl_club AS club_id,
                SUM(fee_eur) AS total_spend
            FROM fact_transfer
            WHERE season = '2023-2024' AND to_pl_club IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY to_pl_club
        )
        SELECT 
            t.rank AS `Hang`,
            t.club_name AS `Cau_Lac_Bo`,
            t.points AS `Diem_So`,
            ROUND(COALESCE(c.total_spend, 0) / 1000000, 2) AS `Chi_Tieu_Mil_EUR`,
            ROUND((COALESCE(c.total_spend, 0) / 1000000) / t.points, 3) AS `Gia_1_Diem_Mil_EUR`
        FROM fact_team_season t
        LEFT JOIN club_spend_2324 c ON t.club_id = c.club_id
        WHERE t.season = '2023-2024'
        ORDER BY t.rank ASC
        LIMIT 10
net_spend_sql:
WITH buying AS (
            SELECT to_pl_club AS club_id, season, COUNT(*) AS buy_count, SUM(fee_eur) AS gross_spend
            FROM fact_transfer
            WHERE to_pl_club IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY to_pl_club, season
        ),
        selling AS (
            SELECT from_pl_club AS club_id, season, COUNT(*) AS sell_count, SUM(fee_eur) AS sales_income
            FROM fact_transfer
            WHERE from_pl_club IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY from_pl_club, season
        )
        SELECT 
            COALESCE(b.club_id, s.club_id) AS club_id,
            c.club_name AS club_name,
            COALESCE(b.season, s.season) AS season,
            COALESCE(b.buy_count, 0) AS buy_count,
            COALESCE(s.sell_count, 0) AS sell_count,
            ROUND(COALESCE(b.gross_spend, 0) / 1000000, 2) AS gross_spend_mil_eur,
            ROUND(COALESCE(s.sales_income, 0) / 1000000, 2) AS sales_income_mil_eur,
            ROUND((COALESCE(b.gross_spend, 0) - COALESCE(s.sales_income, 0)) / 1000000, 2) AS net_spend_mil_eur
        FROM buying b
        FULL OUTER JOIN selling s ON b.club_id = s.club_id AND b.season = s.season
        LEFT JOIN dim_club c ON COALESCE(b.club_id, s.club_id) = c.club_id
roi_sql:
WITH club_spend AS (
            SELECT to_pl_club AS club_id, season, SUM(fee_eur) AS total_spend
            FROM fact_transfer
            WHERE to_pl_club IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY to_pl_club, season
        )
        SELECT 
            t.club_id,
            c.club_name,
            t.season,
            t.rank,
            t.points,
            t.wins,
            t.draws,
            t.losses,
            ROUND(COALESCE(s.total_spend, 0) / 1000000, 2) AS total_spend_mil_eur,
            ROUND(CASE WHEN t.points > 0 THEN (COALESCE(s.total_spend, 0) / 1000000) / t.points ELSE 0 END, 3) AS cost_per_point_mil_eur
        FROM fact_team_season t
        LEFT JOIN club_spend s ON t.club_id = s.club_id AND t.season = s.season
        LEFT JOIN dim_club c ON t.club_id = c.club_id
        ORDER BY t.season, t.rank ASC
